column1: # Pentiment (Switch, base game v0 + update 1.3.2 = v131072). Brought up on the Mac 2026-11-09.
# Obsidian Entertainment's narrative adventure, Unity 2021.3.23f1 IL2CPP with FMOD, SDK 16.2.0, NVN.
# Modules main + subsdk0 (NintendoSDK_movie) + sdk. The standard host and rewriter run this build with no game-specific cut or host change.
# The values below are the NSP script's provisional profile after its heap and address-region checks, confirmed in play.
# The NPDM declares 16 MB of system resource, so the game's memory lives in the alias region.
# The heap check found no SetHeapSize; the address-region check 15 s into nnMain reached alias +4.04 GB of this 4.375 GB region.
# The heap check saw nvnDeviceSetDepthMode with near = 0; pipeline bases made before it must use that mode.
